title: Non-vanishing of the $p$-adic constant for mock modular forms associated to a newform with real Fourier coefficients
summary: Let $F^{+}$ be a mock modular form associated to a normalized newform $g$. K. Bringmann et. al. obtained a $p$-adic modular form starting from $F^{+}$ by adding a suitable linear combination of Eichler integrals of $g(q)$ and $g(q^{p})$. We denote the coefficients of the Eichler integrals of $g(q)$ and $g(q^{p})$ by $γ_{g}$ and $δ_{g}$. These constants are important in the $p$-adic theory of mock modular forms, but relatively little is known about them at present. For instance, K.
